messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty — page fired: ap-southeast-1 / inference-api / p99_latency > 600ms over 5m — alert: latency.p99.high — pd.incident: PD12345
jordan: Acked PD12345. Jumping in.
maya: On it, looking at dashboards (console -> model-endpoints -> inference-api). p99 spiking on seq_len > 1024 requests, KV cache miss rate up.
sam_k: Is this global or region-specific? Any customer-visible 5xxs?
maya: Region-specific to ap-southeast. No spike in 5xxs, but tail latency backpressure on sidecars. Load increased ~2.5x from a campaign.
lee: Rolling mitigation suggestion: enable model-fallback to distilled variant for that route, and pre-scale dedicated pool by 1 node. Also consider temporarily lowering max batch size for that region.
jordan: I can toggle fallback. Maya, can you warm KV cache and clear any stuck batches? I'll pre-scale dedicated pool.
maya: Warming KV cache now: ```curl -X POST https://console.redwood.internal/v1/ops/warm_kv -d '{"endpoint":"inference-api","mode":"hotkeys"}'```
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD12345 acknowledged by jordan. Escalation timer paused.
sam_k: Heads up to Product & Support: potential latency affecting ~4 customers in apac. @product-eng @support — please prepare to notify if impact persists.
maya: Model-fallback toggled to "distilled-v1" for route /v2/generate. Routing rule applied.
lee: Dedicated pool scale requested: +1 G4 node (eta ~90s).
jordan: Pre-scale succeeded, new node joined pool. Observability: p99 dropping from ~720ms -> ~420ms after fallback.
maya: KV cache warm complete. Batch sizes normalized, tail queue depth back to baseline.
sam_k: :thumbsup: Any ongoing error-budget burn we should flag?
jordan: SLO burn reduced. Recommend keep PD open for 30m of stable p99 < 500ms before closing. Root cause hypothesis: traffic skew causing sustained hotkey/kvcache churn + insufficient pre-warm for seq_len heavy requests.
maya: Opening follow-up ticket ENGINF-2026 with telemetry, suggested autoscale thresholds, and a test for routing fallbacks.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD12345 resolved by jordan. Closing page.
lee: Quick postmortem in weekly ops sync; no customer-facing outage, but ops pain.
sam_k: Thanks team — good coordination.
